questions.q: What problem does retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solve?
options: It makes models train faster
It grounds a model's answer in content it wasn't trained on, by retrieving it at request time
It eliminates the need for an API key
It automatically translates text into other languages
questions.explain: RAG retrieves relevant content from your own data and feeds it to the model as context, so answers can reflect information beyond the model's training data.

questions.q: Which of these is one of the four pieces that make up an Azure AI Search setup?
options: Indexer
Load balancer
Virtual network peering
DNS zone
questions.explain: The four pieces are the index, the indexer, the data source, and the query engine. An indexer automates pulling content from a data source into an index.

questions.q: What is the capacity limit on a free-tier Azure AI Search service?
options: Unlimited indexes, indexers, and data sources
One index only, with no indexers allowed
Three indexes, three indexers, and three data sources
There is no free tier available
questions.explain: A free-tier Azure AI Search service is capped at three indexes, three indexers, and three data sources — worth checking via the Usage panel before starting a project.

questions.q: What does the Import data wizard build in a single pass?
options: Only a search index, with no automation
A full Azure subscription
A virtual machine
An index, an indexer, and a data source connection together
questions.explain: The Import data wizard is a no-code tool that builds the index, the indexer, and the data source connection together, instead of configuring each separately.

questions.q: What does Search Explorer let you do?
options: Edit the underlying Azure Blob Storage files directly
Query a finished index directly, without writing any application code
Deploy a chat model
Change your Azure subscription's billing tier
questions.explain: Search Explorer lets you run queries against a finished index directly in the portal, which is the fastest way to confirm the index returns relevant results before any application code depends on it.
